authoring: Source-goal-informed retrospective contract frozen before inspecting candidate audit bodies or results.

adoption.status: Discovery identity only until original addition/source custody is acquired.

goal: For actual versioned Go dependency opportunities, deliver accurate license findings and actionable dependency-condition improvements, independently verified against immutable dependency reachability and original package license declarations, measured in native units per disjoint week.

requirements: Exact module/version exists in the source-era selected Go dependency closure.
An original version-bound license declaration independently establishes the reported license fact.
The finding matches that native fact without substituting a repository's current license for its historical module version.
A claimed transitive chain must be independently reachable; an SPDX label alone does not establish a dependency relationship.
A claimed delivered removal additionally requires actual-parent native dependency closure evidence before and after implementation.

partialAcceptance.unit: independently accurate version-bound license classification facts
partialAcceptance.predicate: The exact stated package/version and its declared license fact agree with an independently retained immutable original; broader transitive reachability, removal, remediation suitability and legal compatibility remain separate when unavailable.
partialAcceptance.classification: Compare explicit license identifiers or original declarations mechanically. GPL-family identifiers are descriptive source facts, not a legal determination of compatibility or obligations.
partialAcceptance.incorrectFindings: Explicit mismatches remain retained native negative observations. An issue, merge, claimed check or successful run is not acceptance.
partialAcceptance.missingFacts: Absent original version/license or dependency identity remains null, never a clean bill or exhaustive zero.

timeAndIdentity.deduplication: Repository, stable finding identity, immutable module version and native condition; no repeat delivery credit from snapshots.
timeAndIdentity.bodyVersion: After-cutoff surviving bodies do not establish original publication-time bytes or accuracy.
timeAndIdentity.historicalGoal: Verify actual applicable source/policy eras before assigning native observations.

separateUnknowns: Full license audit coverage and actual complete transitive closure.
Legal license compatibility and downstream obligations.
Quality and suitability of proposed replacements.
Full behavior preservation and comprehensive safeguards.
Original creation receipts, exclusive causation, matched costs and native keep bar.
deploymentAuthority: None. Read-only acquisition and local deterministic verification only.
